3-1(kha): rgya gar skad du/ma hA sar+ti ni yA marba sarba sa mu dA ya/dz+nyA na
3-2(kha): ga ga na sa sa na taHa/dr-i thi tha ba na sarba gaH/raHb+h+ya ha nA ma/bod skad
3-3(kha): du/rdzogs pa chen po nges don thams cad 'dus pa/ye shes nam mkha' dang
3-4(kha): mnyam pa'i rgyud/lta bsgom thams cad kyi snying po/rin po che rnam par bkod
3-5(kha): pa zhes bya ba/bcom ldan 'das mnyam pa nyid kyi rgyal po rang byung rig pa'i ye
3-6(kha): shes/rtogs pa'i don dang ldan pa/dpal gyi dpal gyur kun tu bzang po la
3-7(kha): phyag 'tshal lo//'di skad gsungs pa'i dus gcig na/kun rig sems kyi
3-8(kha): rgyal po de//'og min chos kyi dbyings gnas na//nges pa'i don la rab
3-9(kha): zhugs te//do rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i//'khor rnams 'dus nas rab
3-10(kha): tu 'khod//de tshe dzo rjze sems dpa'a yis//'dus pa'i tshogs la phan don du/
3-11(kha): kun rig tshes kyi rgyal po la//rang gi rig pas 'di skad gsol//nges don
4-1(kha): gnas lugs snying po yi//de 'khor sprul pa gang gis bskul/sangs rgyas
4-2(kha): bka' rnams ji ltar bgros//ma rig mun pa gang gis sel//de don chos
4-3(kha): rnams ji ltar gsungs//de skad ces ni zhus ma thag/khab len la ni lcags
4-4(kha): 'du bzhin//dad pas rang dbang med par ni/'khor rnams 'dud cing
4-5(kha): bskor zhing bskor//de tshe 'dus pa rnam bzhi yang //dzo rdze gsang ba rin chen
4-6(kha): snying dri med grags pa las raba grub//rgyal ba'i dbang po bsod nams
4-7(kha): snying zhi ba bde dang nyi ma'i 'od/nam mkha'i snying po 'bum gzigs
4-8(kha): dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang bzhugs//rig 'dzin sems
4-9(kha): dpa' chen po yang //blo gros gtso danga rnam dag snying //dam pa'i yon tan
4-10(kha): 'od rlabs can//shes raba bla ma rgyal mtshan 'dzin/rnam par grol ba ting
4-11(kha): 'dzin dbang /chos dbang dang ni spobs pa brtsegs//bdud 'joms dang
4-12(kha): ni seng ge'i sgra//rin chen mthong dang brtse ba can//dbang phyug gtso dang
4-13(kha): brtsegs dge dang //mthong na dga' dang bde mos dang //gsung brtsegs
4-14(kha): la sogs 'khor rnams kun//rang rang gtsa la bskor nas ni//mi brjed pa
4-15(kha): yi gzungs kyis 'khod//rgyal sras sprul pa'i 'khor rnams dang //tshangs pa
4-16(kha): brgya byin rgyal chen bzhi//thags bzang ris dang gang ba bzang //chos kyi
4-17(kha): rgyal po rta mgo can//zur phud lnga pa nor srung dang //mgrin bcu dang ni klu
4-18(kha): rgyal dang //de 'khor la sogs kun kyang gnas//mkha' 'gro sde lnga srin mo'i
4-19(kha): tshogs//ye shes mkha' 'gro rig pa 'dzin/dzo rje mkha' 'gro rigs kyi yum/
4-20(kha): rin chen mkha' 'gro 'dod dgu brgyar//pad+ma mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyas//
4-21(kha): las kyi mkha' 'gro lus sgrib sbyangs//'jig rten mkha' 'gro dam btags
5-1(kha): rtszags zen dzes ngan 'dras paT yan/sa bskam thams cad kya tH/aH ze rnam par bkang
5-2(kha): pa'i//'khor gyi gtor zan po mo kun//nying rje med par gsod la dga'//
5-3(kha): skyon mthong tsa na chad pa gcod//kun kyang srin po'i cha byad can//rthams
5-4(kha): pa'i ba ro 'jigs pa'i tshul//bstan pa bsrung phyir dus der 'dus//sbrul
5-5(kha): sku snang ba'i 'khor rnams ni/dad ldan lha mi las can kun//mos shing dad
5-6(kha): pas 'dus pa yi//las dang thugs rjes 'dzom nas 'khod//de tshe zhus pa'i
5-7(kha): don gsan nas//kun rig chos kyi rgyal po yis//mnyam pa'i don la thugs
5-8(kha): zhugs nas//'dus pa'i tshogs la bka' stsal pa//legs so da da ldan 'khor

5-14(kha): ston pas bka' stsal pa//nges don gnas lugs snying po de//'khor 'das
5-15(kha): 'byung bas ma reg phyir//ma skyes ma btcos rgyas ma mdzad//de nyid ma yengs
5-16(kha): rig par shes//de la 'gro dang 'ong ba med//de phyir rang byung jo bo'i skra//
5-17(kha): da yang dzo rdze sems dpa' nyon//de 'khor sprul pa bskul ba ni//sems dag
5-18(kha): lha dbang rig 'dzin des//rmi lam rnam gsum brda shes pas//mngon dga'
5-19(kha): phug nas 'di skad bskul//dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus kun//gsung gi
5-20(kha): mnga' bdag khyed yin pas//rtsol bcas theg pa mthar bton nas//rtsol
5-21(kha): med theg pa mi gsungs nas/thugs rje chen po yal lam ci/skal ldan
5-22(kha): gdul bya ma mchis sam//lhun grub theg pa bshad du gsol//de skad ces ni

6-14(kha): skad bton//'khor ba'i g.yang sar ltung ba la//thugs rje chen pos mi
6-15(kha): 'dzin nas//re dogs 'dzin pa'i rgyar chud na//rnam rtog dra ba mi gcod
6-16(kha): dam//sems can las la thugs chad na//'gro don snying rjze mi mdzad dam/
6-17(kha): ma rig mun pa'i slag tum du//dmus long bzhin du rang sems 'thib//ye

6-19(kha): chen pos bus//chos nyid rlan gyis mi 'jil lam//'dod chags chu ltar
6-20(kha): 'brub nas kyang /bse rtsi lta bur zhen pa la//ye shes me yis mi bsreg gam/
6-21(kha): don stor lus kyi nang du stor//lam stor bdag la sa mkhan mdzod//de skad
7-1(kha): rdzabs chen zes dan 'das pa'i tun/s bsam thams cad tyaHHrin pa che rnam par bkang pa/
